title: Not one of the six funding types
description: 'wishlist' was considered and dropped; the discriminator stays at six values. Service agreements are a top-level field, not a seventh type. The document carries a well-formed grant-tagged fundingDetails so the top-level enum violation is the single defect: the fundingDetails oneOf is satisfied by the grant shape, and no binding branch's `if` matches 'wishlist', so the binding allOf passes vacuously.
